interpretation_limits: The analysis is descriptive and does not establish that volatility causes venue dispersion.
Realized volatility is measured from the prior 24 hours only to prevent contemporaneous leakage.
Hourly venue closes are not perfectly synchronized executable prices.
The historical relationship can vary materially across subperiods.
Statistical significance must not be interpreted as economic predictability.
lookahead_control: The hourly return ending in the current dispersion bucket is excluded from the volatility estimate.
volatility_definition: Square root of the sum of squared hourly log returns over the 24 strictly preceding observations of the Coinbase-Bitstamp research composite.
